Markets.title: US bond yields climb to multi-year highs as oil surge revives bets on higher Fed rates
Markets.summary: US Treasury yields hit multiyear highs, with the 10-year yield approaching 5 percent. This increase was driven by rising oil prices that revived inflation concerns and boosted expectations for a Federal Reserve rate hike.

Markets.title: Oil surges 5%, Brent and US crude both over $100 on more tanker attacks
Markets.summary: Oil prices surged 5% above $100 a barrel as escalating US-Iran conflict and tanker attacks raised supply disruption fears. Rising Chinese demand and tighter OPEC output further intensified market pressure.

Markets.title: Hotter producer prices strengthen bets on a Fed rate hike
Markets.summary: Hotter-than-expected US producer prices have increased trader expectations that the Federal Reserve will raise interest rates next week. Meanwhile, rising oil prices from the renewed Middle East conflict are further complicating the inflation outlook.

Markets.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Friday
Markets.summary: Indian stock markets snapped a three-session decline to end higher after Sensex and Nifty reversed losses during the closing auction. Despite this recovery, cautious sentiment persisted due to crude oil staying above $102, weak global cues, and rising yields.

Markets.title: Will Bitcoin touch $400,000 by 2030? Coinbase CEO Brian Armstrong answers
Markets.summary: Coinbase CEO Brian Armstrong predicts Bitcoin could reach $400,000 by 2030, maintaining that the target is still reasonable. He believes the cryptocurrency has hit its market bottom and expects upcoming halving events and regulatory updates to drive future growth.

Markets.title: Copper falls after report of White House hesitancy over tariff plan
Markets.summary: Copper prices dropped on the London Metal Exchange and COMEX following reports that the White House is hesitating on potential tariff plans. This hesitation stems from concerns that tariffs would increase manufacturing expenses.

Geo-Political.title: Yemen's Houthis reportedly seize strategic Red Sea port of Mokha
Geo-Political.summary: Yemen's Houthi rebels have reportedly seized the strategic Red Sea port of Mokha. This capture brings the Iran-backed group closer to controlling the Bab al-Mandab Strait, which is a key shipping route.

Geo-Political.title: Can Trump really pay $5,000 to every American adult?
Geo-Political.summary: President Trump has proposed giving $5,000 to every American adult during this election year. However, analysts are questioning whether this financial offer is legally possible, affordable, or practical.

Geo-Political.title: Pilot warned Amazon cargo plane going too fast before deadly crash, data shows
Geo-Political.summary: Flight data shows one pilot warned the other about the Amazon cargo plane's excessive speed while alarms sounded before the deadly crash. The second pilot responded unevenly to the warning just prior to the fatal accident.

Geo-Political.title: Israel's Netanyahu to sue newspaper over claim UAE warned him of 7 October attack
Geo-Political.summary: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is suing a newspaper over a book's claim that the UAE warned him about the 7 October attack. The newspaper stated it stands by its reporting.

Geo-Political.title: Twenty-five dead after fire on cargo ship in eastern China
Geo-Political.summary: A fire on a cargo ship in eastern China resulted in the deaths of 25 people. CCTV reported that 17 of the 42 individuals on board were successfully evacuated.

Geo-Political.title: More than 20 children killed in DR Congo school fire
Geo-Political.summary: A fire engulfed two schools in the rebel-held city of Bukavu in the Democratic Republic of Congo. A stampede occurred as students fled, resulting in the deaths of more than 20 children.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: An online course creator recently discovered that ChatGPT recommended their WordPress SaaS course as the top result without any paid advertising. This experiment highlights a shift in organic traffic strategies from traditional SEO to AI optimization.

AI & Tech.summary: The digital landscape in 2025 requires creators to use artificial intelligence to stay competitive. A new guide highlights the top ten AI tools designed to streamline and revolutionize the content creation process.

AI & Tech.title: LimeWire AI Studio Review 2023: Details, Pricing & Features
AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire has evolved into a generative AI platform that allows users to create digital content. The tool also provides features for creators to share and monetize their AI-generated work.

AI & Tech.summary: This article explores the top ten artificial intelligence tools of 2023 that automate repetitive tasks and improve workflow efficiency across various industries. AI & Tech.summary: This guide covers how beginners can get started and earn money on the CJ Affiliate network. It also highlights top CJ affiliate programs, alternatives, and answers frequently asked questions.

Data & Insights.title: BRICS Summit: Xi Jinping, Putin, Pezeshkian among global leaders attending New Delhi meet – Full list
Data & Insights.summary: Leaders including Xi Jinping, Vladimir Putin, and Masoud Pezeshkian are attending the BRICS summit in New Delhi. Founded in 2006 as a four-nation alliance, the group now includes eleven major emerging markets and developing countries.

Data & Insights.title: US-Iran War shadow over BRICS Summit? Can host India bridge divisions in the Middle East?
Data & Insights.summary: A prolonged US-Iran conflict could disrupt India's energy supplies, trade, and diaspora, increasing its import bill and inflation. India views West Asia as vital to its economy and may attempt to bridge regional divisions during the BRICS summit.

Data & Insights.title: BRICS Summit: How it started, expanded and grew into an 11-nation bloc with 40% of global GDP
Data & Insights.summary: India is hosting the 18th BRICS Summit in New Delhi on September 12–13, marking 20 years since the bloc's 2006 founding. The summit brings together leaders like Vladimir Putin and Xi Jinping as the organization has expanded into an 11-nation bloc representing 40% of global GDP.

Data & Insights.title: Diplomacy tightrope, economic heft test await India at Brics summit
Data & Insights.summary: At the upcoming BRICS summit, India aims to advance cooperation on trade, payments, energy security, and supply chains. Simultaneously, New Delhi must delicately manage its strategic relationships with China, Russia, and the broader Global South.

Data & Insights.title: Goyal bats for common Brics trade platform, women-focused fund
Data & Insights.summary: India's commerce minister proposed a common trade platform for BRICS nations at the Women-Led Development Conference in New Delhi. He also advocated for the creation of a women-focused fund ahead of the bloc's summit.

Data & Insights.title: India-Thailand trade talks focus on market access, Asean trade agreement review
Data & Insights.summary: India and Thailand have agreed to a time-bound review of their free trade agreement to address India's growing trade deficit, which reached $10.81 billion in 2025. Both countries also pledged to strengthen business-to-business connections to promote balanced economic growth.

India.title: CCTV Trail Deepens Odisha Orangutan Mystery, Probe Stretches To Sea Routes
India.summary: Two young orangutans are currently being cared for at a Bhubaneswar zoo while an investigation involving CCTV footage and sea routes tries to solve the mystery of their origin. Police and wildlife officials are using music and mashed apples to keep the six-month to one-year-old animals calm during the probe.

India.title: Runaway Drug Smuggler Tries Makeover To Give Cops The Slip, Gets Caught
India.summary: Aqib Bashir, a drug smuggler who escaped from Narcotics Control Bureau custody in Jammu, was re-arrested in Jalandhar, Punjab. Law enforcement agencies captured him during a joint operation despite his attempt to alter his appearance.

India.title: Assam Police Officer Arrested Over Links With Crude Oil Theft Racket
India.summary: An Assam police officer has been arrested for suspected connections to a crude oil theft ring. The officer's involvement was uncovered during an investigation into criminals who punctured an ONGC pipeline in Sarupathar to steal oil.

India.title: "Just As Sun Rises In The East...": Poll Body Chief Defends Voter Roll Revision
India.summary: During a visit to Gujarat, the Chief Election Commissioner defended the intense public scrutiny facing the institution. He made these remarks while discussing the Special Intensive Revision of voter rolls.

India.title: 6 Killed, 8 Injured As Van, Truck Collide Head-On In Maharashtra
India.summary: Six people were killed and eight others were injured in a head-on collision between a Tata Magic van and a truck in Maharashtra. The accident occurred as the van was traveling from Nanded towards Bhokar and collided with the oncoming truck.

India.title: Voting Machines Can't Be Hacked: Poll Body Chief Gyanesh Kumar Reaffirms In Ahmedabad Speech
India.summary: Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar stated in Ahmedabad that India's voting machines cannot be hacked. He also noted that technology is being integrated to enhance communication within the election machinery.

General.title: Labour mayors in England vow to cap tourist tax at 5%
General.summary: Labour mayors in England have announced plans to cap a new tourist tax on overnight stays at 5%. This proposed visitor levy has faced criticism from both Reform UK and the Conservative Party.

General.title: Oil, gas and borrowing costs surge as fears over Middle East escalate
General.summary: Oil prices jumped to $105 a barrel as escalation in the Iran conflict sparked fears of a prolonged war. This geopolitical tension also caused a surge in global gas prices and borrowing costs.

General.title: Use all powers necessary on anti-migrant protests, home secretary tells police
General.summary: The home secretary has instructed police to use all necessary powers during anti-migrant protests. This directive follows two such protests that took place in Dover and Portsmouth last weekend.

General.title: Can Trump pay $5,000 to every American adult if Republicans win midterm elections?
General.summary: President Trump suggested giving $5,000 to every American adult if Republicans win the midterm elections. Financial analysts question whether this proposal is legal, affordable, or practically workable.

General.title: Watch: Is the Bayeux Tapestry exhibition worth the hype?
General.summary: The Bayeux Tapestry is currently on public display at the British Museum in the UK for the first time in nearly 1,000 years. Crowds are flocking to view the historic artifact during this rare exhibition.

General.title: Four hurt and seven arrested in London stabbing
General.summary: A fight near a London KFC resulted in a stabbing that injured four people. Police arrested seven individuals in connection with the incident.
